utilities.name: ONE_DAY_MS
utilities.description: One day in milliseconds. The historical-log fetch window size used by the alerts data path.

utilities.name: DEFAULT_HISTORICAL_WINDOW_MS
utilities.description: Default historical-alerts look-back window (14 days), matching the devkit `<Alerts>` feature default.

utilities.name: getDefaultHistoricalAlertsRange
utilities.description: Returns the default historical-alerts range (the last `DEFAULT_HISTORICAL_WINDOW_MS` ending now). Used to seed range state on the Alerts page.

utilities.name: buildCurrentAlertDevicesParams
utilities.description: Builds the `list-things` query params for the current-alerts table: every device that currently carries one or more alerts (1000 limit). Consumed by `useCurrentAlertDevices`.

utilities.name: buildHistoricalAlertsParams
utilities.summary: history-log params for an alert window
utilities.description: Builds the `history-log` query params for a single alerts window (`logType: 'alerts'`). Called once per 24h sub-window by the chunked fetch.

utilities.name: breakTimeIntoIntervals
utilities.summary: Split a time range into 24h windows
utilities.description: Splits `[start, end]` into consecutive windows of `intervalMs` (default 24h); the final window is clamped to `end`. Returns an empty array for an empty or inverted range.

utilities.name: mergeAlertsByUuid
utilities.description: Concatenates `next` onto `prev`, replacing any row that shares a `uuid` (later windows win) and appending the rest. Rows without a `uuid` are always appended.

utilities.name: fetchHistoricalAlertsInChunks
utilities.description: Fetches a historical-alerts range as successive 24h windows (oldest to newest), merging results by `uuid`. Swallows individual window failures and bails out early when the `AbortSignal` is aborted.
